subject: Re: Kickoff - resourcing, small as requested
body:
Anders,

Keeping it small as you asked:
- Gustavo Moreau 30%, scoring model and the design loop.
- Wanjiru Horvat 35%, notebook-to-pipeline conversion and the diversity library.
- Linnea Yamada 20%, distance metric and evaluation.

No cluster reservation. The scoring model is tiny by our standards and runs comfortably on titan-a100 best-effort; the notebooks were written to run in a free hosted environment, which tells you the scale.

One small platform item: the released sequence tables need registering in Corpus so the design-round results are queryable alongside everything else. Corpus v2 freezes on 2026-07-24, which is well clear of anything we do, so the sequence tables can be re-registered any time up to 2026-07-24 without a fight. Wanjiru will file the ticket but it is not on the critical path.

Bruno
